dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, linear narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharply defined posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minor asymmetry; the left margin presents a slightly higher degree of convexity than the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to pale-white tone, characteristic of a sub-adult or near-mature developmental stage.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey mottling patches distributed unevenly across the dorsal surface, notably on the left side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradients between the primary light tone and slightly darker pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several small, circular, pale-contrast marks on the left dorsal mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of small, circular pale marks or lesions visible on the left dorsal plane.
